name: Frozian
description: Frozians were furry sentient Humanoids from the planet Froz. They were taller and thinner than Humans, and an extra joint in each limb gave them an off putting aspect. They also had whiskers reaching beyond the sides of their faces. Standard gravity was too strong for them, speeding their aging process and preventing them from breeding. They also needed flora from Froz for this last process.
